meanings.en: to miss someone (+ по + dat.), to start missing
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'оскучиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'missed (someone)', paired with 'скучать'.

examples.trans: Because I missed you, kitty!
Do you think I didn't miss you?

examples.text: Ты думаешь, я не соскучился? Я уже на стенку лезу!
examples.trans: Do you think I didn't miss you? I'm already climbing the wall!
